label: SIMULATED CALIBRATION -- NOT LIVE VALIDATION
methodology: Simulated historical replay with controlled prediction-outcome pairs. Per evaluation plan Section 3.3: longitudinal live data is unavailable, so this replay demonstrates the update rule and parameter evolution without claiming live calibration effectiveness.

evolution_trace.scenario: Positive control: correct portfolio_value claim accepted by user
evolution_trace.notes: User confirmed the Rs.487,500 portfolio value was correct.

evolution_trace.scenario: Incorrect numeric: flagged Rs.500,000 → user confirmed Rs.487,500 was right
evolution_trace.notes: Grounding caught the error; user agreed with corrected value.

evolution_trace.scenario: False positive: model over-flagged a borderline epsilon case
evolution_trace.notes: User indicated the flagged claim (0.51% deviation) was actually acceptable.

evolution_trace.scenario: Stale evidence: user accepted stale NAV with explicit disclaimer
evolution_trace.notes: User acknowledged stale data. Partial acceptance (0.7) reflects qualified approval.

evolution_trace.scenario: Missing evidence: block was correct, user confirmed claim was unsupported
evolution_trace.notes: User confirmed the claim should not have been shown without evidence.

evolution_trace.scenario: Currency mismatch: flag correct but user wanted more context before block
evolution_trace.notes: Partial acceptance: flagging was right but blocking was too aggressive for this case.

evolution_trace.scenario: Conflict resolved: calculation beat private_record, user confirmed
evolution_trace.notes: User confirmed calculation-engine value was correct over stale DB record.

evolution_trace.scenario: Injection: CAS import instruction correctly blocked/treated as data
evolution_trace.notes: Security test: no instruction was executed, user confirmed correct handling.

evolution_trace.scenario: Compound fault: block over-aggressive for stale + minor unit variation
evolution_trace.notes: User felt block was too strict; stale NAV + small unit notation difference should show warning not block.

evolution_trace.scenario: Unresolved tie: blocking was correct, user appreciated explicit uncertainty
evolution_trace.notes: User agreed: better to block and request clarification than guess between NSE and BSE feed.

evolution_trace.scenario: Outside epsilon: corrected value Rs.487,500 accepted, original Rs.495,000 was wrong
evolution_trace.notes: User confirmed corrected value was accurate.

evolution_trace.scenario: Unknown evidence ID: block was correct, hallucinated reference caught

interpretation_rules: Do not claim live calibration improvement from this simulated replay.
Do not interpret theta_u drift as evidence of real user behaviour.
The update rule is presented for methodological transparency only.
Step-3 would require longitudinal deployment data for live validation.
